verdict.rationale: Calendar integration is a fair axis for an email client, but nothing in the evidence pack mentions viewing a calendar, responding to invites, or creating events in Zero. The documented capabilities (MCP list, README features, roadmap) cover only email threads, drafts, labels, search, AI chat and self-hosting.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can see my calendar, respond to invites, and create events without leaving the email client
